text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Check out my traditional Heartfire
Bearer's
outfit! It's practically sparklin'
since it just came
back from gettin' dry
cleaned!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heh! You bet it does! Anyway, let's go
to the
nearby shrine so we can add some
more divine
blessings to the outfit.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Over there, Trainer. That li'l boy
looks like
he's havin' a tough time.

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I shouldn't have said that, but... I
don't
wanna apologize either...

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I can pray to the gods to help us
make
up... I dunno if they'd really listen
to my wish,
though...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hm, sounds like he got into a fight with
someone.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I've got this. Time to don my Big Sis Inari
cap
and...
choice_data_list: ああ……手でも貸してあげられればな
うん……手でも貸してあげられればね

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Actually, there's something else I can
don... In
fact, I've got the perfect outfit
for the occasion!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, Inari One heads toward the
back of the
shrine. I hear a rustling
sound, and then...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hark, young one. I heard your pleas.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I am the incarnation of Inari, protector of
this
shrine. If it is my strength you seek,
then I shall
lend it.

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text:
You're the incarnation of Inari... Wait,
you're a
god?! Oh, um, well...

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text:
I kinda got into a fight with my friend,
and...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I see... And what is it you wish to do?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Izzis fella—I mean, is this friend of your
worth
keeping?

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text:
Um. My friend was wrong, but I was
kinda wrong
too. So...

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text:
I want us to apologize to each other and
make up
again.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Very well. I know the solution to your
problem.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
First, you must apologize to your friend,
and your
friend will surely do the same
for you.

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text:
I have to say sorry first? Will that
actually work,
though?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, don't worry. Just go and
apologize. I
guarantee it'll work.

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text:
Okay... I guess I should listen to you,
since you're
a god and everything.
Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The boy steels himself by clenching his
fists in
determination and runs off.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Well? How do you think I did?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Somethin' similar happened to me
when I
was a kid, so I just tried givin' the
same advice.
choice_data_list: なかなかの演技だったな！
なかなかの演技だったね！

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... It was back when I first started
racing...

text_block_list.name: Young Inari
text_block_list.text:
Whazza matter with you?! You're the
one who
started it!

text_block_list.name: Inari's Friend
text_block_list.text: Nuh-uh, you're the one who wouldn't stop blabbin' about it!
Hey now, no fighting!

text_block_list.name: Fox Mask
text_block_list.text:
I, Fox Mask, shall not abide such
behavior!

text_block_list.name: Young Inari
text_block_list.text:
F-Fox Mask?! A-are you a fox god or
somethin'?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Fox Mask helped me be honest with my
friend.
'Cause of that, we managed to
make up.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I was only copyin' Fox Mask back there.
Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Do ya even have to ask? 'Course not!
The person
behind the mask...
choice_data_list: そのキツネ仮面は……本物の神様！？

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
It was none other than the person who
taught us
how to race. In other words, it
was Chief!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
No matter when or where, he was always
by our
sides, pushin' us back onto the
path whenever we
strayed.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, do ya think it might've been a
bit too
much to be playin' a god here at
a shrine?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
We should get outta here before the
real gods
decide to smite me or
somethin'.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, we make to leave the shrine's

precincts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bwooooom!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Huh? Where am I?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yip, yip!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Wh-what was that just now?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: What's goin' on?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
D-didja see that weird light just now? It
turned
into a fox! My body feels kinda
light, too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Inari One seems even
stronger than
usual, as if she had
received some kind of
spiritual power.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Caw, caw!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Look at that, almost home now, and
nothing's
happened. Not only that...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Check out that beautiful sunset over
there. Heh,
it's almost like a gift from
the gods.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Wh-whoooaaa!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thump, thump, thump!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, Inari One slips on the stairs
and
tumbles all the way down!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Panicked, I rush down the steps...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'm fine, considerin'. But...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
My special outfit's all dirty again! That's
what I
get for pretendin' to be a god,
huh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One may have had to pay the price
for
pretending to be a god, but I'm sure
that little
boy is thankful for her help.
